## Summary

Anish Giri qualified for the 2026 Candidates Tournament by winning the FIDE Grand Swiss Tournament in September 2025. Giri won the Open tournament outright with a score of 8/11, defeating Hans Niemann in the final round. The FIDE Candidates Tournament 2026 is set to take place from 28 March to 16 April at the Cap St Georges Hotel & Resort in Cyprus, and Giri is listed as one of the eight participants, having qualified as the FIDE Grand Swiss 2025 winner.

## The Eight Qualifiers

The Candidates roaster includes Fabiano Caruana, Anish Giri, Matthias Bluebaum, R Praggnanandhaa, Hikaru Nakamura, Javokhir Sindarov, Wei Yi, and Andrey Esipenko.

## Qualification Criteria

The Candidates 2026 consisted of the FIDE World Cup Winner, the top two finishers of the FIDE Grand Swiss, the top three finishers of the FIDE World Cup, the FIDE Circuit winners of 2024 and 2025, and one player by Highest average rating (Aug 2025 – Jan 2026).

## Tournament Details

The tournament took place at the Cap St Georges Hotel and Resort in Pegeia, Cyprus, between 28 March and 16 April 2026. Javokhir Sindarov, the winner of the tournament, advanced to the World Chess Championship 2026 match.

It's worth noting that the runner-up in the World Championship will no longer automatically get a spot in the next Candidates Tournament, and instead will now need to navigate the qualification process.
